query: marche de nettoyage ouvert de plus de 50 millions
note: Constraint-bearing prose, kept deliberately as a documented query.go defect rather than rewritten around it: the value-min filter correctly resolves to 50,000,000 (parseAmount reads the 'm' magnitude suffix as million), but amountPattern's magnitude alternation is NOT sorted longest-first the way the comparison-keyword lists are, so 'millions' matches only its leading 'm' and 'illions' survives as leftover text. Trace: value extraction removes 'plus de 50 m' (not 'plus de 50 millions'), then status extraction removes 'ouvert'; the real residual retrieval text is 'marche de nettoyage de illions', not 'marche de nettoyage'. The stray 'illions'/'de' tokens are retrieval noise from this bug, out of scope for this task. The third notice names one site (Parc SCH2) rather than a general cleaning market, so it only widens intent.
